text:
noah: Quick sync  10min  microsegmented newsletter + drip for benchmark + webinar. Goal: maximize high-intent demo clicks + qualify MQLs. timeline: launch window next Tue-Thu.
tasha: proposed flow (5 msgs): 1) launch announcement (bench highlights) 2) webinar invite (register CTA) 3) deep-dive case study (social proof) 4) benchmark download (post-reg) 5) last-chance reminder + demo CTA. keep brand as 'Redwood Product' but test 'Your Redwood rep' for enterprise seeds.
leah: segmentation: create 4 microsegments -> 
- acq_active: subscribed & opened >=2 in 30d
- acq_passive: subscribed & opened 0-1 in 30d
- trial_engaged: trial users with >10 API calls last 14d
- trial_lapsed: trial users, last activity 15-45d ago
Add exclusion: unsubscribed, gdpr_optout, enterprise_do_not_contact. expected audience sizes: acq_active ~18k, acq_passive ~42k, trial_engaged ~2.6k, trial_lapsed ~1.8k.
aj: deliverability + infra: use SendGrid pool "bench-q2-3"; warmness 85% per ops. throttle 1k/min for ACQ, 300/min for trial cohorts. enable prefix suppression to avoid dupes if someone falls in multiple microsegments. DKIM/SPF validated.
mike: creative: hero 1200x628 + mobile-safe 600x300. include screenshot of latency chart + pull quote. prefer register-first CTA (keeps webinar attendance higher) then send bench download after reg. will drop final assets into /marketing/assets/bench_launch/ by Mon 10am PT.
tasha: testing matrix: for top 2 microsegments (trial_engaged + acq_active) run subject A/B/C x preheader A/B = 6 combos; rest get a simple A/B subject test. sample size ~5k per combo. use utm_campaign=bench_q2_microseg and utm_content=segVariant.
leah: personalization: first-line merge for trial_engaged -> "Noticed heavy API usage — here's how teams cut per-token cost." test vs generic: "New benchmark + live demo." 50/50 split.
aj: tracking & analytics: events: email_sent, email_open, webinar_registered, bench_downloaded, demo_clicked. tag events with "email:bench_q2_microseg" and "segment:<seg_name>". pipe to analytics + CRManalytics.
ops-bot: ESP status: SendGrid pool "bench-q2-3" warmness 85%, projected steady in 48h. Automation check: calendar invites + 24h reminder mapped.
mike: throttle + retry policy: retry on 5xx with exponential backoff, cap concurrent sends per IP to 1.5k/min. set daily cap per recipient = 2 sends for same campaign.
noah: approvals: product (aj), deliverability (aj/lucas), legal (legal@redwood.ai). need approvals by Mon 12pm PT to schedule Tue. QA: internal seeds: noah, tasha, leah, aj, mike + 6 external test emails.
tasha: copy drafts at https://docs.redwood.ai/mkt/bench/microseg-drafts. please leave comments.
leah: automation mapping: registrants -> calendar invite + 24h email; no-shows -> post-webinar bench download; demo clickers -> auto-create lead in CRM and notify AE.
aj: one ops note: for enterprise-sized lists, route through dedicated IP and increase throttles if warmness >90%.
mike: small copy tweak: use "per-token cost" consistently in technical variants.
noah: blockers?
leah: need confirmed audiences from data team by Fri EOD.
aj: approve pending audience check.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: reconvene Mon 11am PT for final sign-off.
tasha: great, thanks all :raised_hands:
